verdict.rationale: Drata is a SaaS compliance platform, so an official MCP server is a fair axis. A probe found an official MCP server documented in Drata's help center (help.drata.com article 13379899), and the developer portal states it enables AI agents to interact with Drata and manage controls through natural language. The 'Drata agent' items concern the device-monitoring agent and are not relevant to this story. missing for 10: details of the MCP server's exposed tools, setup and auth flow, hosted vs local deployment, and any independent or hands-on corroboration that it works.
